subject: Enforce 64‑bit off_t regardless of include order; prevent LTO type mismatch (#2943)
reason: The change is purely compile-time: it adds fmacros.h includes to headers and unit-test files and a static_assert(sizeof(off_t) >= 8) in server.h, so that _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 is in effect before system headers and any include-order regression fails the build rather than producing a 32-bit off_t under LTO. No runtime behaviour, command reply, replication, persistence or protocol path changes in a binary that compiles; the guard it adds can only manifest as a build failure, which the fuzzer (which runs already-built servers) cannot observe. No scenario is needed.
